tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 44 (weekday-qualified week vocabulary). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys. CONTEXT - measured live: from='monday next week' failed to parse and silently fell back to the 14-day default window (125 slots starting the next day), which fed a live patient conversation wrong-day data. The test harness at /home/ankit114/repos/mott-v21-snap/harness/pathway_harness.py (read-only reference, around its qualified-weekday logic) already resolves this form - the gateway must too. BASE FILE: ./deployed-bland_gateway.py is byte-equal to production image mott-lane-43. Produce ./fixed-bland_gateway.py, minimal in-style diff extending resolve_relative_date: (1) '<weekday> next week' and '<weekday> of next week' resolve to that weekday in the next Monday-anchored week (if today is Tuesday 08/04, 'monday next week' -> Monday 08/10). (2) '<weekday> (of|the) (that|the same) week' cannot be resolved without context and must NOT silently default - but '<weekday> (of )?the week of <date-phrase>' (e.g. 'monday the week of 08/18/2026' or 'monday the week of the 18th') resolves to that weekday within the Monday-anchored week containing the resolved date (e.g. Monday 08/17 for a date of 08/18). (3) '<weekday> this week' resolves to that weekday in the current week. (4) IMPORTANT unparseable-from behavior change: when from/to text is present but resolves to nothing, the response must include result field 'from_unresolved': true alongside whatever fallback behavior currently applies, so the pathway can stop trusting mismatched windows; parseable phrases and the none/empty default-window path set it false or omit it. (5) Tests beside the existing suite (frozen-today pattern): 'monday next week' -> 08/10 given today 08/04; 'monday the week of 08/18/2026' -> 08/17; 'friday this week' -> 08/07; regressions for 'thursday', 'in 2 weeks', '2 weeks from today', datetime from/to, and the none default window. Full suite green in ./gwtest (copy of /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW43/gw-oob-refwindow-fix/gwtest with fixed file installed - it carries all cumulative lane tests). (6) ./proof_week.py standalone offline: prints CASE=monday-next-week DATE=2026-08-10 style lines for the three new forms computed against a FROZEN today of 2026-08-04 (inject it; do not use the real clock for these) plus CASE=regression-2weeks DATE=<real today+14> using the real date. (7) DEBUG-GW44.md: evidence, locations, change, output tails, deploy separately gated.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_week.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof crashed'; tail -5 proof.out; exit 1; }; for c in 'CASE=monday-next-week DATE=2026-08-10' 'CASE=monday-week-of-18th DATE=2026-08-17' 'CASE=friday-this-week DATE=2026-08-07'; do grep -q "$c" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: missing $c"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; done; exp=$(python3 -c "import datetime;print((datetime.date.today()+datetime.timedelta(days=14)).isoformat())"); grep -q "CASE=regression-2weeks DATE=$exp" proof.out || { echo 'FAIL: relative regression'; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; cd gwtest && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -10 pytest.out; exit 1; }; echo "$summary" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+ passed' || { echo "FAIL: summary not clean: $summary"; exit 1; }; grep -qi 'from_unresolved' DEBUG-GW44.md || { echo 'FAIL: DEBUG lacks from_unresolved contract'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: week vocabulary proven - $summary"
tasks.verified: The gateway resolves weekday-qualified week phrases (next week, this week, the week of a date) exactly as the harness convention defines, flags unresolvable from-text instead of silently windowing, and every prior lane behavior is unregressed.
